weeklyWatch.label: This week's watch
weeklyWatch.text: Four UK consultation closes fall within the next 30 days: captive insurance on 14 October, equity market transparency on 16 October, and FCA and PRA consultations on 22 October. CP26/30 also addresses resilient market operation during outages. Later confirmed dates are EIOPA's Solvency II application on 30 January 2027 and an HKMA target date on 1 March 2027; no AI-specific date is currently confirmed.
